annotations.title: Resolve a place name to Hemnet location ids

description: Look up Hemnet location ids for a free-text place name (municipality, district, or area). Returns ranked hits with `location_id`, `full_name`, and `parent_full_name`. Feed a `location_id` into hemnet_search_listings / hemnet_search_sold. Read-only.
name: hemnet_autocomplete_location
title: Resolve a place name to Hemnet location ids
